verses.text: "On that day a fountain will be opened for David's family and for the people of Jerusalem, to wash away sin and uncleanness.

On that day," says the LORD of Armies, "I will wipe out the names of the idols from the land, and they will never be remembered again. I will also remove the false prophets and the unclean spirit from the land.

If anyone still prophesies, his own father and mother who gave him birth will say to him, 'You must die, because you have told lies in the LORD's name.' When he prophesies, his father and mother who gave him birth will stab him.
On that day every prophet will be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies. They will not put on a hairy cloak to trick people.
He will say, 'I am not a prophet. I am a farmer. The land has been my work since I was young.'
If someone asks him, 'What are these wounds on your chest?' he will answer, 'I got these wounds at my friends' house.'
"Wake up, sword! Strike my shepherd, the man who is close to me," says the LORD of Armies. "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will scatter. I will turn my hand against the little ones.
In the whole land," says the LORD, "two-thirds will be cut off and die, but one-third will be left.

I will bring that third into the fire. I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on my name, and I will answer them. I will say, 'These are my people,' and they will say, 'The LORD is our God.'"
